note.zh-TW: 課程原字為短期放貨，網站依一般用語寫成短期放款，原字收進別名；日文原型是短期貸付金。
note.en: The course writes this account with a typo; the site shows the usual wording short-term loans and keeps the original as an alias. The term comes from the Japanese short-term loans receivable.

definition.zh-TW: 公司把錢借給別人、預計一年內收回的債權。它是流動資產，也是速動比率的一項；本課的故事沒有用到。
definition.en: Money the business has lent to others and expects to collect within a year. It is a current asset and one of the quick assets; the course story does not use it.
